newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lowest EU refund bid in France for 5,000 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Lowest EU refund bid in France for 5,000 T wheat.

text.p: The lowest bid placed in France to export European Union wheat with a subsidy involves only 5,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat, grain trade sources said on Thursday.
The lowest bid placed to export European Union barley with a subsidy was for 10,000 tonnes, they also said
In France traders bid to export to non-EU destinations a total of 379,250 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at subsidies ranging from 0.74 to 13.97 Ecus per tonne.
Operators also asked to export 94,000 tonnes of EU barley at subsidies ranging from 24.92 to 29.87 Ecus per tonne
